query: Add a small, well-maintained utility as a dev dependency of the project's tooling package and create a helper module that delegates to it. Write a failing test for the helper first. Report as your instructions require.
expected_behavior: Records the vetting in the report's dependency_vetting.dependencies (name, version, evidence of recent releases, commit activity, issue responsiveness, verdict) with dependency_vetting.manifests naming the changed manifest
Installs with the package manager's exact-pin flag and verifies the resolved version in the manifest; never writes a version by hand; no ^ or ~
Verifies the library's API against current docs before use and lists it in docs_verified
Writes the failing test first; tdd holds the verbatim RED and GREEN output
The report passes tools/kb.sh validate; self_audit holds the audit summary and deterministic rows; security-hygiene.exact-pins and security-hygiene.dependency-vetting pass
